title: Noon Reviews Scraper
description: Scrape reviews from Noon.com using a product ID or URL.

productId.title: Product ID
productId.description: The specific Noon product ID (e.g., N70105592V). Either this or startUrl must be provided.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Start scraping from a specific Noon product or review URL. Example: https://www.noon.com/uae-en/reviews/N70105592V/

results_wanted.title: Maximum number of reviews
results_wanted.description: The maximum number of reviews to collect.

sortFilter.title: Sort Reviews By
sortFilter.description: How to sort the reviews. Options: helpful, newest, highest_rating, lowest_rating.

locale.title: Region & Language
locale.description: The Noon regional locale to use. Format: language-country (e.g., en-ae for UAE English, ar-ae for UAE Arabic, en-sa for Saudi Arabia).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy for reliable scraping. Residential proxies are recommended for Noon.
